story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. The courtyard of a Hanoi tube house: a tiled yard with low stools, a charcoal stove and a big pot (kit place: garden); afternoon, night, dawn
2. The family's front room with the ancestor altar (kit place: living-room); dawn
3. Hanoi's old quarter rooftops under New Year's Eve fireworks (kit place: village); midnight

KEY OBJECT (the owner's notes — draw it exactly so): Bánh chưng: a flat SQUARE parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible leaf texture (veins), tied with two pairs of thin pale bamboo strings each way (four strings crossing in a grid, NOT a ribbon, NO bow), a darker green leaf fold at the corners. ONE look only (owner 2026-10-12, D77): the wrapped parcel; the cooking is told by the pot and the fire in the courtyard sets, and the altar by the front room.

Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội. Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt. An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt. Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn. Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân. Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng. Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe. Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ. An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre. Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách. Trên bàn thờ là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.

bible.title: Bánh Chưng Tết
bible.logline: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An học gói bánh chưng từ bà, đêm canh nồi nghe chuyện cổ, sáng mùng Một thức dậy thấy bánh mình gói đặt trên bàn thờ.

cast.name: Bánh chưng
cast.look: Flat square parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible veins, tied with four thin pale bamboo strings in a grid, darker green leaf folds at corners

parts.look: flat square block about as thick as a thumb, wrapped tight in whole leaves, edges sharp and corners folded to points
glossy bright green leaf sheets covering all faces, clear vein lines running lengthwise, darker green triangular folds tucked at each corner
four thin pale bamboo strips, two running left–right and two front–back, crossing in a neat grid on top and bottom, no bow or knot visible
darker green leaf tips folded into sharp triangles at the four corners, tucked under the grid strings

shots.scene: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết - Sân nhà
shots.description: Afternoon golden light fills the narrow tube house courtyard. Grandma sits on a low stool beside the charcoal stove, An kneels nearby on the tiled floor, both facing a woven tray. The big iron pot sits unlit on the stove. Brick walls frame the open sky above.
shots.dialogue: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội.

shots.scene: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết - Sân nhà
shots.description: Afternoon light slants across the courtyard. Grandma's hands spread glossy green dong leaves on the tray, then spoon white glutinous rice, green mung bean paste, and seasoned pork into the center. The charcoal stove glows faintly behind her.
shots.dialogue: Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt.

shots.scene: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết - Sân nhà
shots.description: Afternoon sun catches An's round face as she watches intently. Her small hands mimic Grandma's, folding the leaf edges into sharp right angles, then pulling pale bamboo strings tight in a neat grid. Grandma's wrinkled fingers guide hers from the side.
shots.dialogue: An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt.

shots.scene: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết - Sân nhà
shots.description: Insert shot: the finished square parcel rests on the tray, its glossy green dong leaves showing clear veins, four pale bamboo strings crossing in a precise grid, darker green folds tucked at each corner. Grandma's hand enters frame, thumb tracing the perfect edge.
shots.dialogue: Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn.

shots.description: Night has fallen, lantern glow and firelight paint the courtyard amber. The big iron pot bubbles vigorously on the charcoal stove, steam rising in soft plumes. Grandma and An sit on low stools on opposite sides, the pot between them, brick walls dark against the sky.
shots.dialogue: Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân.

shots.description: Firelight flickers on two faces in over-the-shoulder framing: Grandma leans forward, one hand gesturing toward the simmering pot as she speaks; An sits chin on hands, eyes wide, listening. The pot's steam catches the glow between them.
shots.dialogue: Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng.

shots.description: Firelight close on An's face: round eyes reflecting the dancing flames, mouth slightly open. Grandma's finger points to the square parcel resting on the tray nearby — its green leaf veins sharp in the glow — as she compares its shape to the earth.
shots.dialogue: Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe.

shots.description: Midnight deep blue over Hanoi's old quarter. Terracotta rooftiles stretch into narrow alleys, silhouettes sharp against fireworks blooming — red, gold, green — their light painting the tiles and the upturned faces below. Smoke drifts on the cold air.
shots.dialogue: Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ.

shots.description: Late night, lantern glow dim. An sleeps curled on Grandma's lap in the courtyard, cheek pressed to the dark áo dài. One small hand still clasps a pale bamboo string from the parcel beside them. Grandma's chin rests on An's head, eyes closed.
shots.dialogue: An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre.

shots.description: Dawn light spills through the front room doorway onto wooden floor. An bursts in barefoot, áo bà ba fluttering, round face bright. The ancestor altar dominates the far wall: brass incense burner, twin candles, fresh flowers, a framed photograph. She runs toward it.
shots.dialogue: Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách.

shots.description: Dawn light gilds the altar table. The square parcel sits centered on a red cloth: glossy green dong leaves, veins clear, four pale bamboo strings in a perfect grid, darker folds at corners. Incense curls upward. The framed photograph watches above.
shots.dialogue: Trên bàn thờ là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.
